runs.name: prosody_register_drift
runs.question: does a reworded description of a measured voice keep its measurements
runs.split: 6 of 12 keep every value, 6 change exactly one (rate or f0_span)
runs.why: the same contrast as the wardrobe corpora, moved to prosody: a rewording that drops a unit or rounds a span is drift even when the prose reads the same
runs.curation: tools/corpus-curate.ts style: positive evidence only, a claimed change is kept only if the block value is gone AND a competing value arrived with its unit

not_used.autoscientist: GET /api/v1/autoscientist lists fine-tuning runs (dataset, model, iterations, target_win_rate, best_win_rate, lora hyperparams). it co-optimises data and a training recipe, it does not read literature. the honest use is training a small drift classifier on the curated corpora, not research.
